verdict.rationale: Reflect documents an in-app AI palette with built-in prompts that generate insights such as key takeaways and action items from your notes. It also lets you chat with filtered sets of notes to ask questions and extract information, and offers semantic search with a choice of GPT-4o or Claude 3.5 Sonnet. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of AI insight quality, evidence of proactive (unprompted) suggestions rather than user-invoked prompts.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: You can select from one of our dozen or so prompts, like ‘list key takeaways’ or ‘list action-items’.
List action-items and key takeaways from meeting notes
After applying any desired filters to the search, you can also "chat" with those specific notes to ask questions and extract information.
You can also ask the AI palette anything you'd like using the open text field, and save it as a custom prompt to quickly call on again later.
Reflect's AI tools give you the option to now use either GPT-4o (the latest model from OpenAI) or Claude 3.5 Sonnet (the latest model from Anthropic).
